details: a host name check splits the host once, and a certificate with 100 or more names gives `x509: certificate is valid for N names, but none matched HOST` instead of listing them, as Go (GO-2025-4155, GO-2026-5037). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/x509, std/tls; native backends): a host name check splits the host once, and a certificate with 100 or more names gives `x509: certificate is valid for N names, but none matched HOST` instead of listing them, as Go (GO-2025-4155, GO-2026-5037). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
